tools.name: captcha_solve_recaptcha_v2
tools.description: Resolve um desafio reCAPTCHA v2. Retorna um token (gRecaptchaResponse) pra submeter no site alvo. Cobrado em créditos pré-pagos por solve.

tools.name: captcha_solve_recaptcha_v3
tools.description: Resolve um desafio reCAPTCHA v3. Retorna um token (gRecaptchaResponse). Informe a page_action esperada pelo site. Cobrado em créditos por solve.

tools.name: captcha_solve_hcaptcha
tools.description: Resolve um desafio hCaptcha. Retorna o token pra submeter no site alvo. Cobrado em créditos por solve.

tools.name: captcha_solve_turnstile
tools.description: Resolve um desafio Cloudflare Turnstile. Retorna o token. Cobrado em créditos por solve.

tools.name: captcha_solve_image
tools.description: Resolve um captcha de imagem (texto distorcido). Envie a imagem em base64; retorna o texto reconhecido. Cobrado em créditos por solve.

tools.name: captcha_get_result
tools.description:
Consulta o resultado de uma task de captcha já criada, pelo task_id. Não é cobrado (a cobrança ocorre na solve que criou a task).

Bulk support: accepts task_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: show_version
tools.description: Show the current MCP platform and adapter versions.

tools.name: report_bug
tools.description: Report a bug, missing feature, or send feedback. Include the conversation array with recent messages for reproduction.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Returns connection status and URLs. When all providers are connected, returns authenticated:true and empty pending[]. When credentials are missing, returns connect_url for the toolkit and per-install URLs.

tools.name: toolkit_info
tools.description: Returns the current toolkit state: installed MCPs, their connection status, the accounts connected to each one, and how many catalog tools each exposes.
